variants.prompt: Hazel reclines sultrily on a plush velvet chaise in a dimly lit, crimson-hued boudoir. The soft glow of flickering candelabras casts a warm, inviting ambiance. A crystal champagne flute rests precariously on her hip, and a trail of discarded silk lingerie leads from the bed to her outstretched legs. The DSLR captures her in a shallow focus, the blurred background a sensual blur of rich textiles and ornate furnishings.
